---
title: SHOT
---


[`shot.holycross.edu`](https://shot.holycross.edu) has been on the internet since 2004. I'm continuing to manage a small web server there, and in 2026 am beginning to repurpose it as a home where I can host some scholarly datasets and apps.

Apps:

- a searchable [Lewis-Short *Latin Dictionary*](https://shot.holycross.edu/lexica/lewis-short/)
